title: Tinman prepared process
description: Everything the PTY runner needs to launch a process, with no backend knowledge. Referenced by features/prepared-process.feature.

program.description: Absolute path to the program the PTY runner launches.

env.description: Environment as name/value pairs. A backend that clears the environment produces the full set here.

cwd.description: Working directory, or null to inherit the launch directory.

cleanup.description: Descriptors of temporary resources to reclaim after the process ends.
